description: Land Title Settlement Department - Elapitiwala, Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 512009
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, ownership details (all listed as "The State"), and legal classifications. The content falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
